object.attr: derived: the restore can fail for the same reason the write did, a full disk or a file held open on Windows, and the agent then has to know what is on disk (CF-M33). Kept as the fallback of MELLON-MCP-SRS-70 rather than withdrawn (review Q3). Today `new_object` and `bulk_set_attribute` return `partial` after any failure partway, which MELLON-MCP-SRS-70 replaces.
object.description: If a write tool call fails and the MCP server can't put each file back as the file was before the call, the MCP server shall return `partial`, listing each file left changed.
